West Plains/Hayford Outage Update- 11/17, 1:30 AM

Tonight's outage was caused by a vehicle striking an Avista transmission pole that feeds our West Plains members. The accident also damaged Inland Power equipment and lines in the area.

Avista crews are replacing their transmission pole, while Inland Power crews make emergency repairs to our damaged poles, wire, and equipment. Both crews are working together to restore power as safely and quickly as possible.
Estimated restoration: 7:00 AM

Thank you for your patience. We'll share updates as we have them.
